title: 第四章 还好主角不是我
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
事实上，正如它的名字，这是一个黑暗，充满了死亡与破坏，而且永远无法翻身的世界。人类的挣扎所换来的，永远只有一时的平静，但是这段日子过不了多久，就会被毫不留情的打破。就好像太阳终会升起，冰雪终将融化一样。
而更重要的是，这是一个对主角很不友好的世界。
别看在游戏里，主角个个神挡杀神佛挡杀佛，可事实上，暗黑贯穿三代，几乎没几个主角有善终的。
暗黑第一部里的三个主角，战士把大菠萝的灵魂石插到自己脑中，试图用自己强悍的意志压制大菠萝的邪恶灵魂。然后果不其然的被大菠萝腐化，堕落，接着成为了大菠萝复活的道具。其他两人也好不到哪儿去，要么死后被转化为邪灵，要么屈从于邪恶意志腐化堕落，最后都变成了BOSS然后被第二部的主角干掉了，当然，作为后继者的主角们同样不得善终………杀掉魔王回家和公主结婚那就真是白日做梦，这些人要么失踪要么被人干掉。
别的世界里，主角光环都是保命的，但是在这个世界里，主角光环却是要命的！
也正因为如此，在搞清楚这个世界之后，方正第一反应就是松了口气………还好主角不是我！
如果他没有记错的话，自己穿越的应该是暗黑破坏神第三部，现在剧情是开场部分，一颗流星从天而降砸掉了崔斯特姆教堂，迪卡凯恩的孙女莉娅召集民兵试图找到自己的爷爷，而就在这个时候，主角奈非天闪亮登场，然后就这么踏上了一条不归路………嗯，不归路。
虽然方正脑中记忆里对于这一部的剧情记得不是很清楚了，不过他相信，这倒霉催的奈非天日后绝对没好结果。哪怕是打败了大菠萝又如何？反正这个世界对主角的恶意那是杠杠的，要么被老朋友派来的刺客怼死，要么因为魔法失控倒霉伤重身死，又或者被邪恶力量影响腐化堕落从而变成了给下一代主角送装备的BOSS………
这么倒霉催的主角光环，谁爱要谁要，反正方正是敬谢不敏的。
“咚咚咚…………！！”
就在方正喝完肉汤之时，忽然一阵急促的脚步声传来，接着只见一个民兵跑进了旅馆。
“方正！拉姆福德长官要你立刻前往大门！那些该死的亡灵又出现了！我们必须挡住他们！”
“我知道了！”
听到这个民兵的说话，方正也没有再说什么，急忙站起身跟着那个民兵离开旅馆。这时雨已经停了，四周多多少少也能够看见几个人。不过他们大多神色紧张，急促不安。不过此刻方正也没有心情去关心这些人，他来到大门前，只见拉姆福德队长也已经换了一身衣服，此刻正指挥其他民兵制作路障，看见方正，拉姆福德立刻挥了挥手。
“快，方正，快来帮忙，我们刚才击退了一波亡灵的袭击，它们………该死！”
没等拉姆福德把话说完，方正就看见右侧的路障“砰”的一声被打烂，接着数个活死人缓步走了进来，它们两眼发光，摇摇晃晃的朝着大门走了过来。而看见这一幕，其他几个民兵顿时也紧张了起来。他们紧握着手中的武器，大气都不敢喘的看着眼前的怪物。
与此同时，方正的耳边也响起了“叮”的一声系统提示音，随后一行信息显示在了方正的眼前。
【场景任务触发：守卫者】
【黑暗而邪恶的力量已经降临，文明的火焰已如同风中残烛，末日的考验即将到来，你所能够做的，只有接受挑战，面对那一片漆黑的未来（抵挡住不死生物的袭击，保卫城镇安全，任务成功学习技能 1，次元点数 1）】
终于来任务了！

看见自己眼前的任务，方正也顺势拔出了自己的霜之哀伤，不过看着其他人如临大敌的样子，他内心还是有些纳闷。方正对于这个世界的了解仅限于游戏，剧情和设定。至于这个游戏之中的怪物强度，他并不是十分了解。但是在方正看来，这些活死人真没有什么值得特别警惕的地方，它们的速度非常慢，而且也不像生化危机之类的世界中那些丧尸还会变异和进化，如果是那些带光环的首领精英，那么说不定还有点儿威胁。可是这些走路一摇三晃的活死人，至于让拉姆福德这样身经百战的战士如此紧张吗？

content_en:
In fact, as its name suggests, this is a dark world full of death and destruction that can never be turned around. What human beings struggle to gain is always only a moment of peace, but this period of time will not be long before it will be broken mercilessly. Just like the sun will eventually rise and the ice and snow will eventually melt.
And more importantly, this is a world that is very unfriendly to the protagonist.
Although in the game, the protagonists are all trying to kill gods and Buddhas, but in fact, Darkness has lasted for three generations, and almost few protagonists have a happy ending.
The three protagonists in the first part of Diablo, the warrior inserted the soul stone of the big pineapple into their own brains, trying to suppress the evil soul of the big pineapple with their strong will. Then as expected, he was corrupted and degenerated by Big Pineapple, and then became a prop for Big Pineapple's resurrection. The other two were not much better either. They were either transformed into evil spirits after death, or succumbed to evil will and became corrupted. In the end, they both became BOSS and were killed by the protagonist of the second part. Of course, the protagonists who were the successors also did not have a happy ending... Killing the demon king and returning home to marry the princess was really a daydream. These people either disappeared or were killed.
In other worlds, the protagonist's aura is life-saving, but in this world, the protagonist's aura is life-threatening!
Because of this, after figuring out the world, Fang Zheng's first reaction was to breathe a sigh of relief... Fortunately, the protagonist is not me!
If he remembered correctly, he should have traveled through the third part of Diablo. The plot is now in the opening part. A meteor fell from the sky and destroyed the Tristram Church. Deckard Cain's granddaughter Leah summoned the militia to try to find her grandfather. At this time, the protagonist Nephalem made a shining appearance, and then embarked on a path of no return...well, a path of no return.
Although Fang Zheng didn't remember the plot of this movie very clearly in his mind, he believed that this unlucky Nephalem would never end well in the future. So what if I defeat Big Pineapple? Anyway, the world's ill will towards the protagonist is extremely bad. Either he is killed by an assassin sent by his old friend, or he is unluckily injured and dies due to out-of-control magic, or he is corrupted by evil forces and becomes a BOSS who sends equipment to the next generation of protagonists...
Whoever likes such an unlucky protagonist wants to have it, and Fang is the one who appreciates it anyway.
"Dong dong dong...!!"
Just as Fang Zheng finished drinking the broth, there was suddenly a burst of rapid footsteps, and then a militiaman was seen running into the hotel.
"Founder! Chief Rumford wants you to go to the gate immediately! Those damn undead have appeared again! We must stop them!"
"I know!"
After hearing the militiaman's words, Fang Zheng didn't say anything more and hurriedly stood up and followed the militiaman out of the hotel. The rain had stopped by this time, and a few people could be seen around. But most of them looked nervous and anxious. However, Fang Zheng was not in the mood to care about these people at this moment. When he came to the gate, he saw that Captain Rumford had also changed his clothes and was directing other militiamen to build roadblocks. When he saw Fang Zheng, Rumford immediately waved his hand.
"Quick, Fang Zheng, come and help. We just repelled a wave of undead attacks. They... damn!"
Before Rumford could finish speaking, Fang Zheng saw the barricade on the right being smashed with a bang, and then several living dead walked in slowly, their eyes glowing, and they staggered toward the door. Seeing this scene, several other militiamen suddenly became nervous. They held the weapons in their hands tightly and looked at the monster in front of them without even daring to breathe.
At the same time, a "ding" system prompt sounded in Fang Zheng's ears, and then a line of information was displayed in front of Fang Zheng's eyes.
[Scenario mission trigger: Guardian]
【Dark andThe power of evil has arrived, the flame of civilization is like a candle in the wind, and the test of doomsday is coming. All you can do is accept the challenge and face the dark future (resist the attack of the undead, defend the safety of the town, successfully learn the skill 1, and gain 1 dimension point)]
The mission is finally here!
Seeing the task in front of him, Fang Zheng also took advantage of the situation and pulled out his Frostmourne. However, seeing the others acting like they were facing a formidable enemy, he was still a little puzzled. Founder's understanding of this world is limited to games, plots and settings. As for the strength of monsters in this game, he didn't know much about it. But from Fang Zheng's point of view, there is really nothing to be wary of about these living dead. They are very slow, and unlike zombies in worlds such as Resident Evil, they can mutate and evolve. If they are elite leaders with halos, then they might still be a bit of a threat. But do these swaying living dead make a battle-hardened warrior like Rumford so nervous?
